rows.grounds: Locative of sampuṭa, the enclosing union/container mentioned in the preceding verse.
Qualifies vidyā as highest or ultimate.
Accusative object denoting the vidyā attained or present in that context.
Compound describing the vidyā as having the very nature of all vidyās.

items.question: What supreme knowledge, embodying all knowledges, is present within that union?
premises: The locus is the sampuṭa described previously.
The object present there is a supreme vidyā.
This supreme vidyā has the intrinsic form of all vidyās.
items.inference: Within that union, the supreme vidyā is realized as the essence encompassing all forms of knowledge.
uncertainties: The governing verb is carried over from the preceding context and is not explicit in this verse.
items.plain_english: In that union, there is the supreme knowledge whose very nature is all knowledge.
